title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I am a 33 year old Indian male from Mumbai, staying in workig in Abu Dhabi. I have pproximately 20-22 years of Qada namaz. I came across a site called www.islamicacademy.com giving the following easy way of praying For the people who have many years of missed Salahs. There is a way to pray them quickly. Following instructions have four exeptions and has all Fards and Wajibs for a complete Salat. Please pray your Qaza as soon as possible. Even of you could pray one days Qaza Salahs every day which are only 20 rakahs (3 wajib witr), please do it. It only takes few mins to perform 20 rakahs according to the following instructions. 1) In Ruku and Sajdah instead of reciting "Subhaana Rabbiyal Azeem" and "Subhaana Rabbiyal A'la" three times, say it only once. But make sure do not leave Ruku poster untill the Meem (M) of Azeem has been said properly. Similarly do not leave the posture of Sajdah until Ala has been said completely. Just make sure to say these Tasbeehaat properly and do not rush. 2) In third and four Rakah of Fard Salah instead of reciting the whole Soorah Fatiha say, "Subhan Allah" three times and go to Ruku, . Make sure "Subhan Allah" has been recited three times properly, do not rush. This exeption is only for Fard. In third rakah of Witr it's a must to recite full Soorah Fatiha followed by at least three ayahs of Quran or a soorah (as we usually do in first and second rakah). 3) In last Qaidah (when we sit for Attahyyat) before Salam, after Attahyyat instead of full Durood and Dua just say, "Allah Humma Salle Ala Sayedena Mohammad Wa Aalihi", then finish the Salat with Salam. Dua is not a must here. 4) In Witr, instead of full Dua-e-Qunoot just say "Rabbigh Fir Lee" one or three times. (Fatawa Rizvia, Part 3, Page 622) Can you please advise if the above method can be followed sagely 2924 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 56217 Country: India Title: Namaz qasr or full Question: My sister’s birth place is Mirzapur in Uttar Pradesh. She married to a person belonging to Sitapur. Now both are working in Lucknow and living in Lucknow on rented house. Distance between Mirzapur to Sitapur is 490 km & Mirzapur to Lucknow is 400 km & Lucknow to Sitapur is 90 km. For living less than 14 days in Mirzapur or Lucknow or Sitapur where will be full salah and where Qasr. Answer ID: 56217 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 39/18/SD=01/1436) After marriage, when the girl makes intention to live at her husband’s home permanently then her mother’s home is no more her native place rather her in-laws home where she lives with her husband permanently becomes her native place. Hence in the question mentioned above, your sister shall offer qasr salah in Mirzapur her birth place, as well as in Lucknow as they have not made it their native place hence they shall offer qasr salah there as well. ويبطل الوطن الأصلي بمثله لا السفر ووطن الإقامة بمثله والسفر والأصلي لأن الشيئ يبطل بما هو مثله لا بما هو دونه فلا يصلح مبطلا له ..............والوطن الأصلي: هو وطن الإنسان فى بلدته أو بلدةٍ أخرى اتخذها داراً وتوطن بها مع أهله وولده وليس من قصده الارتحال عنها بل التعيش بها وهذا الوطن يبطل بمثله لا غير (البحرالرائق 2/239 ط: زكريا ديوبند) من جاوز بيوت مصره مريداً سيراً وسطاً ثلاثة أيام فى بر أو بحر أو جبل قصر الفرض الرباعي. (ايضاً). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
